connect.title: Do ka kple LinkedIn
connect.intro: Ge ɖe eme kple LinkedIn akɔnta si kpɔa wò boblododowo dzi. Leadrat xlẽa wò boblododo ƒe akɔntabubuwo, Lead Gen Form ƒe ŋgɔdonyawo kple boblododo ƒe akɔntabubuwo ko, eye wòɖoa dzimetɔtrɔ siwo nèʋu la ɖa.
connect.need1: Akpa aɖe si woawɔ le LinkedIn boblododo ƒe akɔnta me (Nukpɔla alo esi de ŋgɔ wu).
connect.need2: Dɔ aɖe si woawɔ le dɔwɔƒe si do ƒome kplii ƒe axa dzi (Dzikpɔla, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator alo Analyst) - LinkedIn bia tso esi be wòama kplɔlawo.
connect.need3: Telefon xexlẽdzesi ƒe nyabiase aɖe le wò Lead Gen Forms dzi - womateŋu atsɔ lead siwo si telefon xexlẽdzesi mele o akpe ɖe eŋu o.

connection.fetchHint: Woléa ŋku ɖe ame yeyewo ŋu le miniti ʋɛ aɖewo ɖesiaɖe me eye wogbugbɔ léa ŋku ɖe ŋkeke 7 mamlɛawo ŋu gbesiagbe, eyata naneke metoa eme o. Zã esia na kaƒoƒo siwo tso hafi nèdo ka, alo be nàgalé ŋku ɖe ɣeyiɣi aɖe ŋu ake (vaseɖe ŋkeke 90 le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me). Wodzona le kplɔ siwo le Leadrat xoxo la dzi.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Gblɔ na LinkedIn be eƒe ŋgɔdolawo dometɔ kae va zu mɔkpɔkpɔ ŋutɔŋutɔwo. Ne LinkedIn kplɔla ɖo nɔnɔme si nètia le ete gbɔ la, Leadrat ka nya ta na LinkedIn , ale be wò dɔdzikpɔha ƒe nyatakakawo ɖea kplɔla ƒe nyonyome fiana eye LinkedIn ateŋu akpɔ ame geɖe abe wò kplɔla nyuitɔwo ene. LinkedIn lead ID kple email la ƒe hash si yia mɔ ɖeka dzi koe woɖona ɖa.
capi.noRules: Womewɔ nɔnɔme aɖeke ƒe nɔnɔmetata haɖe o.
capi.created: Tɔtrɔ si wowɔ le LinkedIn eye wowɔ anyigbatata.
